facts: Direct dataset readback shows 2,792,111 title-boundary entities.
Dataset summary describes title boundaries as indicative position and extent of registered property.
Origin includes some MHCLG-created data and replacement with authoritative sources is ongoing.
Licence is Open Government Licence v3.0.
2026 HM Land Registry copyright/database attribution is required.
2026 Ordnance Survey attribution applies to polygon geometry coordinates.
Coordinate queries return entities whose geometry intersects the supplied point.
Coordinate query inputs are WGS84 / EPSG:4326.
Multiple dataset parameters can be supplied in one coordinate query.
UPRN q-search is described as more precise for registered properties.
The API has no batch endpoint; per-property requests are recommended.
Bulk downloads are recommended for hundreds of properties or more.
Planning Data publishes an OpenAPI document at /openapi.json.
New INSPIRE files are published on the first Sunday of each month.
INSPIRE polygons are downloadable by local authority.
London Borough of Barnet is listed with a GML download.
London Borough of Enfield is listed with a GML download.
GIS software is required to view the downloaded INSPIRE polygons.
Downloading the INSPIRE files implies agreement to OGL conditions.
INSPIRE contains locations of freehold registered property in England and Wales.
INSPIRE is a subset of HM Land Registry Index Polygons for freehold land/property.
Each INSPIRE polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID linked to a registered title.
HM Land Registry says the INSPIRE ID can be used with Find a Property to obtain title registration and plan.
HM Land Registry data is captured against the British National Grid.
GML data may need reprojection for web mapping systems.
HM Land Registry warns BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection may shift some features by up to 15 metres.
INSPIRE is free, monthly, OGL, average 13.66 MB GML, and has no API.
LIDAR_Tiles_Catalogues FeatureServer uses spatial reference EPSG:27700.
FeatureServer supported query format is JSON.
Layer 0 is LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Extents.
Layer 0 supports JSON, GeoJSON and PBF query formats.
Layer 0 describes capture date, DTM resolution and transformation models for survey extents.
Layer 0 contains an os_ref field suitable for tile-reference filtering.
Layer 0 contains pt_spacing for point spacing provenance.
Layer 0 contains transform and geoid provenance fields.
Layer 0 contains filepath, supplied, latest and polygon_id fields.
Layer time extent spans 2005 through 2022 and Has Live Data is false.
EA WCS GeoTIFF NoData value is -3.4028235e+38.
OS Terrain 50 is available as a 50m grid in ASCII and GML 3.2.1.
Online download is available with no registration required.
National tiled supply contains 2,858 tiles arranged into 55 100km-grid folders.
The tiled product is designed for annual full-tile resupply.
OS Terrain 50 is supplied annually each July.
ASCII grid heights are calculated at pixel centres.
Each ASCII tile has 200 pixels per row.
ASCII height values are supplied to the nearest 0.1m.
The ASCII header includes ncols 200 and nrows 200.
OS Terrain 50 grid is a DTM with regular 50m post spacing.
OS Terrain 50 contour data has 10m interval standard contours.
Tiles are identified by the National Grid reference of their south-west corner.
OS Terrain 50 provides GEMINI metadata on a per-tile basis.
